Module advanceWars
Package co.edu.unbosque.model.persistence

Class FileHandler

java.lang.Object
co.edu.unbosque.model.persistence.FileHandler
public class FileHandler extends Object
The FileHandler class provides static methods to handle creating, read and write files in the application, including serializable files. serializable. Main methods: - verificarFolderDeDatos(): Verifies and creates the “data” folder if it does not . exists. - abrirYEscribirEnSerializable(String, Object): Writes a serializable object in a file. - abrirYLeerArchivo(String): Reads the contents of a text file. - abrirLeerSerializado(String): Reads a serializable object from a file. - abrirYEscribirArchivo(String, String): Writes content to a. text file. This class also uses the MensajeEmergente class to display. error messages or information in case a problem occurs during file operations.
Author:

      public void reproducir(String rutaArchivo)
      Plays an audio file located at the specified file path. This method attempts to load and play the audio file in a continuous loop. If the file does not exist or an error occurs while loading the audio, the method logs the exceptions.
      Parameters:
